page_title: FRA 3-0 SWE | France v Sweden 30/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Danny Makkelie is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+4' Mattias Svanberg (Sweden) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
90+3' Benjamin Nygren (Sweden) tries to find Besfort Zeneli with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
90+2' Jean-Philippe Mateta (France) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The current number of corner kicks is 9:1. Fouls committed – 11:10.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gustaf Nilsson (Sweden) comes onto the pitch so that Alexander Isak can be given a rest.

89' Viktor Gyökeres (Sweden) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the bottom right corner from a promising distance, but Mike Maignan denies him.
88' The linesman signals that Bradley Barcola (France) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
86' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Mattias Svanberg (Sweden) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
86' Anthony Elanga (Sweden) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
85' Didier Deschamps has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rayan Cherki (France) replacing Michael Olise.
85' Substitution. Jean-Philippe Mateta (France) on for Kylian Mbappe.
84' Michael Olise (France) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
82' Michael Olise (France) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
82' Graham Potter decides to make a substitution. Yasin Ayari will be replaced by Benjamin Nygren (Sweden).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mattias Svanberg (Sweden) comes onto the pitch for Daniel Svensson.
82' Bradley Barcola (France) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop. France win a corner.
81' Half-chance! Besfort Zeneli (Sweden) plays a pass into the box, but Mike Maignan reacts well to snuff out the attack.

81' Desire Doue (France) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.
79' Besfort Zeneli (Sweden) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Viktor Gyökeres, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
79' 22:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 10:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
78' Substitution. Lucas Digne walks off the pitch and Theo Hernandez (France) comes on as a substitute.
77' Desire Doue (France) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
75' Didier Deschamps has decided to substitute Ousmane Dembele and he is replaced by Desire Doue (France).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jules Kounde as he is replaced by Malo Gusto (France).

74' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Kylian Mbappe (France). Michael Olise plays a fantastic through ball and finds Kylian Mbappe (France), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the right side of the goal. It's now 3:0.
73' Alexander Isak (Sweden) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
73' Taha Ali (Sweden) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and France will have a goal kick.

71' Michael Olise (France) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
71' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
71' The attendance for today's match is 80663.
68' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
68' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Sweden) plays a long ball to Anthony Elanga, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear. The ball has crossed the sideline. Sweden are taking a throw-in.
67' Alexander Isak (Sweden) attempts to find Viktor Gyökeres with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
66' Michael Olise (France) takes the corner with a short pass.
66' Here is a change. Lucas Bergvall is going off and Graham Potter gives the last tactical orders to Besfort Zeneli (Sweden).
66' Substitution. Taha Ali (Sweden) replaces Elliot Stroud.

65' He should have scored! Michael Olise (France) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. France have been awarded a corner kick.
63' Ousmane Dembele (France) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jacob Widell Zetterstrom intercepts the ball.
63' France hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
62' Michael Olise (France) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

61' Michael Olise (France) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Jacob Widell Zetterstrom, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes out of play and France have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Kylian Mbappe (France) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Adrien Rabiot, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
59' Half-chance! Jules Kounde (France) plays a pass into the box, but Jacob Widell Zetterstrom reacts well to snuff out the attack.
58' Gustaf Lagerbielke (Sweden) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
57' Daniel Svensson floats over the corner and Lucas Bergvall (Sweden) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the left post.
56' Daniel Svensson (Sweden) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
56' An attempted cross from Anthony Elanga (Sweden) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Sweden.
55' Victor Lindelof (Sweden) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
53' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Michael Olise tees up Bradley Barcola (France) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top left corner and past Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.
52' Ousmane Dembele (France) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
51' The France players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
50' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
49' Bradley Barcola (France) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for France.
47' Lucas Bergvall (Sweden) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
46' Anthony Elanga (Sweden) sprays a pass out to Viktor Gyökeres, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
46' Referee Danny Makkelie blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Daniel Svensson (Sweden) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

45+2' Anthony Elanga (Sweden) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Elliot Stroud (Sweden) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 0 Kylian Mbappe (France) scores from the resulting corner. The ball slips through the box to Kylian Mbappe (France) and he blasts it inside the right post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
45' Ousmane Dembele (France) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

45' Michael Olise (France) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Jacob Widell Zetterstrom! France have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
44' Jules Kounde (France) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
43' Michael Olise (France) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

43' Bradley Barcola (France) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. France will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' Michael Olise (France) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
42' Bradley Barcola (France) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
41' Yasin Ayari (Sweden) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
41' Adrien Rabiot (France) trips an opposition player and Danny Makkelie signals a foul. Sweden win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
40' Kylian Mbappe (France) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass, but Jacob Widell Zetterstrom has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.

39' Dayot Upamecano (France) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
39' Danny Makkelie blows his whistle for a foul after Lucas Bergvall (Sweden) hacks down one of his opponents. France earn a free kick.
36' Anthony Elanga (Sweden) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alexander Isak, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for France.

36' Michael Olise (France) fires a volley from just outside the box and the ball smashes against the right post. Ousmane Dembele (France) has an opportunity, but isn't able to direct the ball into the net.
34' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:2. The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.
33' Adrien Rabiot (France) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.

32' OFF THE POST! Kylian Mbappe (France) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
31' Ousmane Dembele (France) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
31' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Michael Olise (France), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

30' Great save! Adrien Rabiot (France) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Jacob Widell Zetterstrom. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to France.
30' Michael Olise (France) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
29' Ousmane Dembele (France) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
28' Ousmane Dembele (France) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Corner kick. France will have an opportunity.
28' Alexander Isak (Sweden) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan makes a magnificent save!
27' Adrien Rabiot (France) tackles a bit over-zealously and Danny Makkelie blows for a foul. Sweden are awarded a free kick.
26' The match can continue after the interruption.
23' A cooling break is underway.
22' Michael Olise (France) jumps into a tackle and Danny Makkelie signals a foul. Sweden are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
21' Celebrations are cut short for France as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
21' The France players joy may have been justified, because referee Danny Makkelie is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
20' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Kylian Mbappe (France) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

19' Bradley Barcola (France) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms over the bar.
19' Daniel Svensson (Sweden) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
18' Danny Makkelie interrupts the game for a tactical foul by William Saliba (France). It's a free kick to Sweden in a dangerous position.
17' 66:34 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

17' Kylian Mbappe (France) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a low shot towards the middle of the goal from distance, but Jacob Widell Zetterstrom hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.

16' Lucas Digne (France) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Jacob Widell Zetterstrom!
15' Ousmane Dembele (France) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
15' A lofted cross from Jules Kounde (France) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. France win a corner kick.
14' Foul! Lucas Bergvall (Sweden) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
12' The ball is cleared after Ousmane Dembele (France) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sweden.
12' Elliot Stroud (Sweden) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and France will have a goal kick.
10' Some neat passing and movement from France as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
8' Yasin Ayari (Sweden) commits a rough challenge and Danny Makkelie blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Michael Olise (France) sends a long cross over to Bradley Barcola, but Jacob Widell Zetterstrom comes forward to gather the ball.
5' Good defending. Ousmane Dembele (France) tries to find Kylian Mbappe inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
5' Michael Olise (France) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
4' Referee Danny Makkelie sees the trip by Yasin Ayari (Sweden) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. France are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

3' Alexander Isak (Sweden) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
2' Lucas Digne (France) produces a cunning chipped pass for Kylian Mbappe, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball. It's a throw-in for Sweden.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Sweden will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Danny Makkelie.
